description: File system sidebar should open full-width on mobile devices so users can read file names without rotating to landscape

userStories.title: Full-width file tree sidebar on mobile viewports
userStories.description: As a mobile user viewing files in Orchestra, I want the file system sidebar to open at full horizontal width on mobile viewports so that I can read file names and navigate the tree without rotating my device.
acceptanceCriteria: On mobile viewports (< 768px), the file tree sidebar panel opens at full width (100% of the panel group) instead of 20%
On desktop viewports (>= 768px), the sidebar retains current sizing (defaultSize=20, minSize=15, maxSize=35)
The resize handle between sidebar and editor is hidden on mobile since the sidebar is full-width
The collapse/expand toggle still works on mobile to switch between file tree and editor views
Lint passes (npm run lint from frontend/)
Verify in browser using agent-browser skill
userStories.notes: Key file: frontend/src/components/panels/FileEditorPanel.tsx. The <Panel> component around FileTreeSidebar needs mobile-responsive props. Use a useMediaQuery hook or window.matchMedia('(max-width: 767px)') to detect mobile. On mobile, override Panel props to defaultSize=100/minSize=100/maxSize=100 or equivalent.
